sanskrit_verse:
साक्षिभिर् गदितैः सभ्यैः प्रक्रान्ते निर्णये तु यः ।
पुनर्विवादं कुरुते राजा तत्र विचारयेत् ॥
transliteration: sākṣibhir gaditaiḥ sabhyaiḥ prakrānte nirṇaye tu yaḥ | punarvivādaṃ kurute rājā tatra vicārayet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When witnesses have testified and the assembly has reached a verdict, whoever raises dispute again, the king shall investigate therein.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the collective testimony of qualified witnesses
Causation is established through sequential manifestation of evidence
Capacity-based responsibility requires alignment with witnessed truth
Restoration logic demands resolution without re-litigation
Consciousness alignment occurs when repetition of conflict ceases
executable_legal_axioms: IF witness testimony is complete AND assembly verdict is declared THEN any subsequent challenge MUST be reviewed ONLY for procedural integrity
IF new dispute arises AFTER final declaration by assembly THEN king SHALL NOT revisit merits BUT verify witness authenticity and intent
IF repetition of case occurs WITHOUT NEW causal data THEN system MUST trigger consciousness-realignment protocol for disputant
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, once a bench of qualified jurists (sabhyah) has rendered judgment based on sworn testimony (sākṣibhiḥ), further appeals invoking same facts are inadmissible unless gross procedural flaw is demonstrated. The court's role shifts from adjudication to restoration of societal harmony through enforcement of finality.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that repetition of litigation after valid conclusion disrupts dharma-vyavasthā; anupūrvaśaḥ shows escalation as disorderly manifestation; proportional responsibility lies not in punishment but in cessation of repetitive conflict; non-punitive reality rule enforces completion rather than retaliation.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process: Require disputant to publicly acknowledge prior verdict before assembly
Assume responsibility protocol: Disputant must declare personal readiness to align with concluded truth
Capacity restoration mechanism: Facilitate reintegration into community through service aligned with dharma
Integrity reintegration sequence: Reconnect disputant with original witnesses to reaffirm mutual understanding
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law proceeds from the Supreme Pontiff alone. Dharma stands restored where repetition ends and consciousness realigns. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness itself is the ultimate judge.
